description: A Perl script for flashing firmware on D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices, involving network device discovery via UDP broadcast, FTP communication for firmware transfer, and device reboot.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for device-specific commands such as getenv and reboot.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends reboot command to FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot device via FTP.
